fun_facts: Ryan Fitzgerald is from Coolidge, Georgia.
At Florida State, Ryan Fitzgerald made a 59-yard field goal in 2024; it was his career long and the second-longest in school history.
As a rookie, Ryan Fitzgerald made four game-winning field goals, tied for the most by any rookie since 2000.
Ryan Fitzgerald played in all 17 games in 2025 and was only the second rookie kicker in Panthers history.
Ryan Fitzgerald earned NFC Special Teams Player of the Week after making all three field-goal attempts—including one from 55 yards—and all three extra points in a win over Dallas.
